title: TopologyRelationshipQualifierOptionItem
description: One scoped option for a relationship qualifier. The value is typed so numeric VLAN ids, string VRF names, and boolean qualifiers do not need lossy string coercion.

value.description: Typed qualifier value to send back in TopologyRelationshipIntent.qualifiers.

label.description: Human display label for clarification prompts or UI controls.

description.description: Optional short explanation of the option.

catalogIds.description: Optional semantic catalog ids that help explain this option.

metadata.description: Optional non-contractual metadata for diagnostics or display. Clients must not depend on hidden view ids or graph internals here.
